name: Ao no Shigyaku Midori no Higyaku
original_name: 青の嗜虐 緑の被虐
source:
The protagonist gets to view the story from two perspectives, one from the POV of a female master and the other of a slave. The story takes place in a kingdom where slavery is legal. The wealthy nobles buy these slaves as jewels to embellish themselves with or as toys to fulfill their desires. Every person takes the law as a given, and accepts these actions as facts. That is why commoners work their very best to avoid lowering their positions to slaves. In such a scenario, you stand out as the odd one - you don’t treat slaves like slaves, you don’t stoop so low in front of your master either. And that is precisely why you will receive an extraordinary ending. 

[from [url=http://wakannaiyo.tumblr.com/post/115556568128/ao-no-shigyaku-midori-no-higyaku-since-i-alluded]Wakannaiyo's Tumblr[/url]]
translation:
主角从两个角度来看待这个故事，一个是女主人的视角，另一个是奴隶的视角。故事发生在一个奴隶制合法的王国。富有的贵族购买这些奴隶作为珠宝来装饰自己，或者作为玩具来满足自己的欲望。每个人都将法律视为理所当然，并将这些行为视为事实。这就是为什么平民竭尽全力避免将自己的地位降为奴隶。在这种情况下，你就显得很奇怪了——你不会像对待奴隶一样对待奴隶，在你的主人面前你也不会卑躬屈膝。这正是为什么你会得到一个非凡的结局。

[来自[url=http://wakannaiyo.tumblr.com/post/115556568128/ao-no-shigyaku-midori-no-higyaku-since-i-alluded]Wakannaiyo的Tumblr[/url]]
